mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stompall_room ( roomName, deleteFlag, count ) VALUES ( #{roomName}, 0, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE stompall_room SET count = #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE stompall_room SET deleteFlag = true WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id , roomName , deleteFlag , count FROM stompall_room WHERE id = #{id} AND deleteFlag = false
SELECT id , roomName , deleteFlag , count FROM stompall_room WHERE 1=1 AND deleteFlag = false ORDER BY id ASC
